title: Would + verbo sem to
regra: Depois de would e wouldn't o verbo vem direto, sem to: I would visit, she would travel, I wouldn't work. É igual ao can: I can swim (e não 'can to swim').

fofoca.gaps: If I won the lottery, I would [[buy]] a house by the beach. I would [[visit]] my grandma every week. And I wouldn't [[work]] on Mondays! My sister says she would [[travel]] around the world. She would [[go]] to Japan first.

options: I would to visit my grandma.
She would travel around the world.
She would to travel around the world.
She will travel around the world.
I wouldn't to work on Mondays.

falar.en: She would travel around the world.
